    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->

+"""Recorded RoboWits ball_onto_tower trajectory (rcb-limited/2.2).

+

+

+

+        "reason=", result.meta.get("reason"),
+        "time_left_s=", result.meta.get("time_left_s"),

+        video_fps=10,
+        cameras=CAMERAS,

+
+

+    obs = robot.get_obs(
+        cameras=CAMERAS,
+        seconds=seconds,
+        video="both",
+        video_fps=10,
+        depth=True,

+        "gripper_opening=", round(float(p[62]), 4),
+        "gripper_effort=", round(float(p[71]), 3),
+    )
+
+
+def set_right_gripper(robot: Robot, opening: float, name: str) -> None:
+    p = state(robot)
+    action = p[:16].copy()
+    action[7] = opening
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "joint_position",
+        action,
+        dt=0.3,
+        video="both",
+        video_fps=10,
+        cameras=CAMERAS,
+        note=f"Set right gripper opening to {opening:.3f} m",
+    )
+    save_result(result, name)
+
+

+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
